body: Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission
agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 21, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jodi Meade, Commissioner
Karen Blair, Vice Chair  Aaron Tofani, Commissioner
Ryan Hofman, Commissioner  David Witzling, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52605  Recommendation to receive and file Chair’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52596  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the meeting held February 15, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52597  Recommendation to receive and file financial report for the period ending February
  29, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52598  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  status report for February 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52602  Recommendation to approve a proposal from Waxie Sanitary Supply to purchase
  12 Big Belly receptacles at a cost of $39,777.11.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52603  Recommendation to approve a proposal from Quality Commercial Cleaning Inc
  (dba Spectrum Facility Maintenance) to provide sidewalk and alley steam cleaning
  services through September 30, 2024 at a cost of $49,600.00, and approve an
  optional as-needed second service weekly steam cleaning proposal at a monthly
  cost of $6,495.00.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Page 1 of 2
   BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVIDORY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 21, 2024
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

7.  24-52604  Recommendation to approve a proposal from CSI Patrol Services to provide
  security services in Belmont Shore from the hours of 8am to 5pm from Monday to
  Sunday, 2am to 6am from Sunday to Thursday and 12am to 6am from Friday to
  Saturday.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their
comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Teri A. Luce, Asst Admin Analyst, Dept of Public Works certify that the agenda was posted not
less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings.
